nom: AXIS-Y Complete No-Stress Physical Sunscreen V.3

avis.titre: WORKS! Wore every day on island vacay
avis.texte: I have really fair skin, so protection that works is important! I wore this every day on my weeklong island vacay and didn't burn once. I also wear it every day at home, for daily protection. There's no scent, no tint, and little to no white cast, which makes it a really stellar physical sunscreen. Hope they restock because this really is the GOAT. Round Up's Birch Juice Mild Up UVLOCK 50 is a close second.

Oh my god!!! I took the chance on this sunscreen because I saw it on a TikTok skincare haul, and the creator liked this product. let me just say so worth it!! This product is great for acne-prone skin, no crazy fragrance smell, lightweight, doesn't leave me a greasy mess with the CRAZYYY US East Coast humidity, doesn't pill when mixed with my other skin care or applied under makeup, and doesn't leave a crazy white cast if used properly. (I did notice if you use too much and don't rub it in fully, it might, but that's user error) plus it comes with two, sooo worth the price since this will last you months...so glad i bought this!!
I got this from the brand itself for free but NOW i buy this myself. Its my favorite sunscreen which even brightens (my favorite quality about it). I love how theres a pack of 2 being sold at ulta.

i LOVE this sunscreen. i have to use mineral/physical sunscreens because chemical sunscreens burn my eyes and break me out very badly. i really prefer to use PA++++ sunscreens since i'm asian prone to sun spots, but there aren't many here in the US market. i have combo skin (balanced to slightly oily t-zone with the rest of my face being on the dry/dehydrated side). this soaks into my skin so well and doesn't leave me feeling or looking greasy at all. it leaves a slight matte shine (oxymoron, i know lol) without the stickiness. i also love that it isn't tinted. while i understand that tinted sunscreens offer more UV protection, i wear makeup most days anyways and don't need a tinted sunscreen underneath to make me look more greasy/cakey under my foundation. plus on days i do want to have a bare face, it's nice not having a tinted sunscreen that looks like i have foundation on. i've tried other popular mineral PA++++ like tatcha, prequel, and round lab. this one is my fav! tatcha is too greasy and the tint is too much coverage for my liking, plus it's very expensive. prequel has less tint to it, but still left me looking a little greasy by the end of the day. this is such an affordable price and it's formulated so elegantly. this is now going to be my holy grail sunscreen!
